title: Samaria and Samaritans
summary: Samaritans were a people with historical, religious, and ethnic tensions with Jews in the first century.
background: This background makes Jesus’ ministry in Samaria and His parable of the good Samaritan especially striking, because grace crosses long-standing hostility.
teachingHelp: When teaching Samaritan passages, explain the hostility enough for listeners to feel the shock of mercy, worship, and mission across barriers.
sources: International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, original 1915 edition.
Alfred Edersheim, Sketches of Jewish Social Life in the Days of Christ (1876).
